required_changes_injected: FAIL Criterion 4 (Actionable Next Steps): All three critical next steps use '[Contact TBD]' as placeholder, which is acceptable per rubric exception for early-stage deals. However, the next steps for Decision Criteria and Decision Process both use vague language: 'ask' without specifying WHO will ask or WHEN. Rewrite as: '[Primary contact name TBD]: By 2026-08-11, ask during call: "Of the criteria we discussed — Snowflake, statistical rigor, visual editor, cost — how are you ranking these? Is there a written evaluation checklist?"' Similarly for Decision Process: '[Primary contact name TBD]: By 2026-08-11, ask: "Walk us through approval sequence — who reviews contract, who gives legal sign-off, who makes final call?"' Current phrasing 'On the next call, ask' lacks specificity on contact and concrete deadline. FAIL Criterion 2 (Carry-forward Consistency): Decision Criteria score increased from 9/10 (cumulative) to 8/10 (current) without documented reason. Analysis states 'Call 3 introduced no new decision criteria' and 'one point of incompleteness' but this contradicts the prior 9/10 score. Either maintain 9/10 with note 'No new criteria in Call 3 — maintaining previous score' OR explicitly document what new information caused the 1-point regression. Current analysis is internally inconsistent. FAIL Criterion 1 (Complete Coverage): Champion status marked as 'Partial' but score is 1/10. Per rubric, Partial status requires evidence of some progress toward identification. Score of 1/10 with language 'No named individual has been identified' and 'no champion can be confirmed' contradicts Partial status. Should be 'Unknown' status with 1/10 score, or provide evidence of partial progress (e.g., 'CRO team identified as user group, but no individual advocate named yet') to justify Partial. Current classification is contradictory.
